tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Figures, inspector, node fill.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Wells. ink-3 fails 4.5:1 here on Paper (about 4.2:1); use ink-2. No focal text on sunk (4.38:1 on Paper).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside panels.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Section rules. Not control borders: those use control. Draw a 1px rule under the Night banner.

tokens.name: focal
tokens.usage: Current position, one at a time per view, at stroke-route weight. Never colour alone. Never text on sunk.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, solid lines, pressed pills. Not numerals on node fills: those use on-node.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary prose, connector verbs, captions, annotations.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Kickers and legends on ground or surface only.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: Notice band. On Night, add a 1px rule line under the band.

tokens.name: banner-ink
tokens.usage: Text on banner.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Border for pills, tabs and buttons. 4.75:1 on Paper, 6.96:1 on Night.

tokens.name: on-node
tokens.usage: Numerals and text on node fills. 4.3 to 9.5:1 across all eight nodes.

tokens.name: role-act
tokens.usage: Triad position 1 (acts). Dots, rings, chips only. Never text.

tokens.name: role-decide
tokens.usage: Triad position 2 (decides). Dots, rings, chips only. Never text.

tokens.name: role-record
tokens.usage: Triad position 3 (records). Dots, rings, chips only. Never text.

tokens.name: way-1
tokens.usage: Way one. Border, 9px dot, or stroke. Not text colour. Not focal.

tokens.name: way-2
tokens.usage: Way two. Border, 9px dot, or stroke. Night hex matches role-decide. Left as specified.

tokens.name: way-3
tokens.usage: Way three. Border, 9px dot, or stroke. Night hex matches role-record. Left as specified.

tokens.name: node-1
tokens.usage: Node 1 fill and route segment. 1.6px ink outline. Colour names a corner, not a sequence. Label in on-node.
